# Pet

> Stat-boost pets: hatch from eggs, equip, client pet panel (P key).

- Package: `Pet` · Category: Gameplay & world
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Codex](Codex.md), [Data](Data.md), [Economy](Economy.md), [Guard](Guard.md), [ItemDef](ItemDef.md), [Loot](Loot.md), [UI.Toast](UI.Toast.md), [UI.UIController](UI.UIController.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Pet")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("UI.PetController")` on the client

## `GaxiaServer.Pet`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/PetService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Pet = GaxiaServer.Pet
```

### Functions

- `Pet.GetCoinMultiplier(player: Player): number`
  Returns 1 + Σ coinBonus of every currently-equipped pet. A game multiplies its own coin grants by this (the faucet is the game's; this service never grants). Returns a neutral 1.0 until the profile has loaded (no pets equipped yet anyway), so a faucet calling this in the join window never errors.
- `Pet.GetOwned(player: Player): { PetInstance }`
- `Pet.GetEquipped(player: Player): { string }`
- `Pet.GrantPet(player: Player, petId: string): string?`
- `Pet.BuyEgg(player: Player, eggId: string?): (boolean, string)`
- `Pet.Equip(player: Player, uid: string): (boolean, EquipResult)`
- `Pet.Unequip(player: Player, uid: string): (boolean, UnequipResult)`
- `Pet.Snapshot(player: Player): PetSnapshot`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Pet.OnPetGranted` — `Signal<Player, string, string>`
  (player, petId, uid) after GrantPet added a pet to the profile
- `Pet.OnEquipChanged` — `Signal<Player, { string }>`
  (player, equipped) after Equip / Unequip; equipped = a copy of the equipped uid list

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type PetRarity = "common" | "uncommon" | "rare" | "epic" | "legendary"
export type PetDef = {
    displayName: string,
    rarity: PetRarity,
    coinBonus: number,
    weight: number,
    pity: number?,
    icon: string,
}
export type PetInstance = { petId: string, uid: string }
export type PetPublicDef = { displayName: string, rarity: PetRarity, coinBonus: number, icon: string }
export type PetSnapshot = {
    owned: { PetInstance },
    equipped: { string },      -- equipped uids, in equip order
    multiplier: number,        -- GetCoinMultiplier for this state
    slots: number,             -- max pets equipped at once
    eggCost: number,           -- Coins per BasicEgg
    defs: { [string]: PetPublicDef },
    order: { string },         -- stable display order of pet ids
}
export type EquipResult = "equipped" | "bad uid" | "not owned" | "already equipped" | "all slots full"
export type UnequipResult = "unequipped" | "bad uid" | "not equipped"
```
